## listing-heroes: GPU pipeline
1. Set **repo** in Config (or POST {"listing": "<id>"} to the webhook).
2. Run. Every job in pipeline/listings/<id>.json is queued on both ComfyUI servers at once, then collected.
3. Depth maps are converted to disparity PNGs (Execute Command: start n8n with NODES_EXCLUDE="[]").
4. Transitions get a 50 fps copy.

n8n needs N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO=<repo path> to read photos and write outputs.
